digest.lead: Claude Code gets Windows PowerShell support in its latest v2.1.84 release, marking a significant expansion for Windows developers.
digest.summary: Meanwhile, a surprising winner emerged from Anthropic's recent hackathon, showing Claude's potential beyond traditional tech use cases.

stories.headline: Mozilla Partners with Anthropic on Firefox Security Initiative
stories.summary: Anthropic announced a new security collaboration with Mozilla Firefox [1]. Details of the partnership remain limited in the initial announcement.
stories.impact: This partnership could bring Claude's capabilities to Firefox's security infrastructure, potentially affecting millions of browser users.

stories.headline: Claude Code v2.1.84 Adds PowerShell Support for Windows Developers
stories.summary: The latest Claude Code release introduces PowerShell tool support as an opt-in preview for Windows users [1]. The update also includes new environment variables for customizing third-party model providers like Bedrock and Vertex, plus configurable streaming timeout settings [1].
key_points: PowerShell tool now available as preview for Windows development workflows
New environment variables allow customization of third-party model provider settings
Configurable streaming idle timeout via CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
stories.impact: Windows developers can now leverage Claude Code with native PowerShell integration, while enterprise teams using third-party providers gain more deployment flexibility.

stories.headline: Lawyer Wins Anthropic Hackathon, Challenging Tech-Centric Assumptions
stories.summary: A lawyer took first place at Anthropic's recent hackathon, surprising many who expected traditional tech solutions to dominate [1]. The victory highlights Claude's potential applications beyond conventional software development use cases [1].
stories.impact: This win demonstrates Claude's versatility for non-technical professionals and could inspire more diverse applications across legal, business, and other professional domains.

sources.title: A lawyer won Anthropic's hackathon – what everyone missed

stories.headline: Configure streaming timeout for better connection handling
stories.summary: The new CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS environment variable lets you customize how long Claude Code waits before timing out idle streaming connections. This helps prevent unnecessary disconnections during long-running operations.
actionable_steps: Choose a timeout value in milliseconds (default is 90000 for 90 seconds)
Restart Claude Code for the setting to take effect

stories.headline: Use managed settings drop-in directory for team policy deployment
stories.summary: The new managed-settings.d/ directory allows multiple teams to deploy independent configuration fragments that automatically merge. This enables better organization of team-specific policies without conflicts.
actionable_steps: Create a managed-settings.d/ directory alongside your managed-settings.json
Place individual team policy files in the directory (they merge alphabetically)
Name files with prefixes to control merge order (e.g., 01-team-a.json, 02-team-b.json)

stories.headline: Enable PowerShell tool for Windows development workflows
stories.summary: Claude Code now includes an opt-in PowerShell tool that allows Windows users to execute PowerShell commands directly through Claude. This provides native Windows command-line access for system administration and development tasks.
actionable_steps: Update Claude Code to version 2.1.84 or later
Enable the PowerShell tool in your settings as a preview feature

stories.headline: Use Claude's extended thinking for complex architectural decisions
stories.summary: When asking Claude to make non-trivial design choices — like choosing between patterns, structuring a new module, or planning a migration — enabling extended thinking produces significantly better results. Claude will reason through trade-offs before committing to an approach, catching issues that quick responses miss.
actionable_steps: For architecture questions, ask Claude to 'think through the trade-offs' explicitly
Use Claude Code's plan mode (shift+tab) for multi-step tasks that need careful reasoning
Review Claude's reasoning in extended thinking to catch flawed assumptions early

sources.title: Tips for getting better architectural advice from Claude

stories.headline: Write a CLAUDE.md file to set project conventions once
stories.summary: Adding a CLAUDE.md to your project root lets you define coding standards, test commands, and architectural decisions that persist across every Claude Code session. Think of it as onboarding documentation that Claude reads automatically — you teach it once instead of repeating yourself.
actionable_steps: Create a CLAUDE.md in your project root with build/test/lint commands
Add coding conventions like naming patterns, preferred libraries, and file structure
Include architectural decisions and constraints Claude should respect
Use /init in Claude Code to auto-generate a starter CLAUDE.md
